package_id: manufacturing-ontology
domain_id: manufacturing
version: v1
imports: []
object_types:
  - id: InventoryLot
    primary_key: id
    properties:
      - name: id
        type: string
        required: true
        immutable: true
      - name: quantity
        required: true
        immutable: false
    implements: [Transferable]
    description: "Inventory lot"
link_types: []
interfaces:
  - id: Transferable
    required_properties:
      - name: id
        type: string
        required: true
        immutable: true
    required_links: []
    capabilities: [read, transfer]
functions:
  - id: available_quantity
    inputs:
      - name: lot
        type: {ref: InventoryLot}
        required: true
    output: integer
    purity: NO_COMMITTED_BUSINESS_SIDE_EFFECT
    reads: [InventoryLot.quantity]
    implementation_ref: "fn:available_quantity:v1"
    determinism: deterministic
actions:
  - id: transfer_inventory
    inputs:
      - name: lot
        type: {ref: InventoryLot}
        required: true
      - name: quantity
        type: integer
        required: true
    authority_refs: ["auth:inventory-transfer"]
    policy_refs: ["policy:inventory-transfer"]
    preconditions: ["quantity > 0", "available_quantity(lot) >= quantity"]
    effects:
      - target: WMS
        operation: external_call
        fields: [quantity]
    idempotency: required
    outcome_predicate: "CDC-observed WMS state satisfies expected transfer effect"
    compensation_action: null
    version: v1
policies:
  - id: inventory-transfer
    decision: allow
    expression_ref: "policy:inventory-transfer:v1"
    version: v1
authority_rules:
  - id: inventory-transfer
    principal_selector: "role:planner"
    capability: "action:transfer_inventory"
    resource_selector: "InventoryLot:*"
    effect: allow
    delegation_allowed: true
observation_types:
  - id: InventoryObserved
    subject_type: InventoryLot
    properties:
      - name: quantity
        type: integer
        required: true
        immutable: false
    source_binding: wms-cdc
    truth_status: observed
constraints:
  - id: nonnegative-inventory
    scope: InventoryLot
    expression_ref: "constraint:quantity>=0"
    severity: hard
metadata: {example: true}
